All backed by 20+ years of data. PORTFOLIO PERFORMANCE See what’s in-form & what’s out-of-form in your portfolio Get a clear snapshot of how your portfolio is performing. Updated monthly. FUND PERFORMANCE Know exactly what to do with each fund Start SIP, Pause SIP, or Exit Get clear actions, as recommended by our in-house experts. PAST TRENDS Also see how your funds have performed in the last 2 years Use this to see the consistent performers in your portfolio. And make stronger decisions. MONTHLY REPORTS Get a clear view of any shifts in your portfolio Status indicators highlight shifts in your portfolio allocation and fund performance categories, including in-form, on-track, and out-of-form funds.
